name: Big Island
about: The Kona (west) side is dry and sunny most of the year, while Hilo (east) is genuinely rainy — dry season May–Sep is best overall, and Mauna Kea's summit is one of the best stargazing sites on Earth nearly any clear night.
overview: An active volcano you can walk right up to at Kilauea, a snow-capped dormant peak hosting some of the world's best astronomical observatories, black and green sand beaches, and world-famous Kona coffee — Hawaii's most geologically diverse island.
costOverview: Similar to Maui but with a bit more range at the lower end — Kona coffee and poke bowls stay reasonable, while the guided volcano and stargazing tours are the real splurges.
